# Animation Studio Specialists

When another workflow delegates to a named specialist, select the matching prompt below, read it completely, and use it as the instructions for that delegated task. Source model and tool allowlists are advisory because Codex skills cannot enforce them; use least privilege.

- `animation-ideator` — Brainstorms animation concepts from rough specs. Use when the user has a vague idea ("make it feel alive") and needs concrete animation proposals. Read `../../../agents/animation-ideator.md` before delegating.
- `animejs-creator` — Generates anime.js and Web Animations API animations for plain HTML, server-rendered templates and non-React components (Vue, Svelte, Astro and similar). Use for SVG animations, complex timelines, and non-React animations. Read `../../../agents/animejs-creator.md` before delegating.
- `motion-creator` — Generates Motion (motion.dev) animation components for React. Use when the animation target is a React component, in a React app (Next.js, Vite, Remix) or as a React island in a partially hydrated site. Read `../../../agents/motion-creator.md` before delegating.
- `video-creator` — Orchestrates Remotion video creation for marketing and product content (social clips, product demos, feature announcements). Designs scenes and animation choreography, and uses the remotion-best-practices skill for technical patterns when it is installed. Read `../../../agents/video-creator.md` before delegating.
